steps.title: The second page, with no copying
steps.look: Berries uses the same layout, with its own title. There's one nav for the whole site.

steps.look: The fetch moves above the fence, with a response.ok check. No "Loading…", because the names are in the HTML when it arrives.

steps.title: A helper for the base path
steps.look: url('berries/') puts the site's base in front of the path, whatever the base is.
